 4struct Node {

11void insertAtPos(int val, int pos) {
12    struct Node* newNode = (struct Node*)malloc(sizeof(struct Node));
13    newNode->data = val;
14    if (pos == 1) {
15        newNode->next = head;
16        head = newNode;
17        return;
18    }
19    struct Node* temp = head;
20    for (int i = 1; i < pos - 1 && temp != NULL; i++) {
21        temp = temp->next;
22    }
23    if (temp == NULL) {
24        free(newNode);
25        return;
26    }
27    newNode->next = temp->next;
28    temp->next = newNode;
29}

31void deleteVal(int val) {
32    if (head == NULL) return;

34        struct Node* temp = head;

36        free(temp);
37        printf("Deleted %d\n", val);
